d: After Indian captain Shubman Gill won the toss and opted to bowl on a green surface, India dominated the morning session to reduce the hosts to 70/5. However, Henry Nicholls and Glenn Phillips batted through more than four hours without losing a wicket, putting together an unbeaten 173-run sixth-wicket partnership to put New Zealand in a strong position. Thanks to the recovery, New Zealand reached 243/5 in 82 overs at stumps on Day 1 of the 1st Test against India at the Basin Reserve in Wellington.
